All right. Can I have a meeting set up today for two? Bye-bye. Ready?

expect.text: All right. Can I have a meeting set up today for two?

turns.say: Yeah, I didn't know I was going to promote. And, uh... And I'd say it is. It's fascinating, isn't it?
And I tend to come out. So do I.

note: Harsha's real call 56f51277 on the pilot (srv14), 15 Oct 23:13-23:16Z (04:43 SLT). Harsha: he never said 'Bye-bye. Ready?', 'You're on.', 'you know', 'It'll be fun.', the 'promote' line or 'And I tend to come out. So do I.': Whisper made them up from noise, silence or echo (turns with noise: true carry Whisper's own scores, no_speech_prob 0.9). Was: the request was replaced by the made-up fragments and got 'I'm not sure what you mean'; made-up lines got 'That sounds nice/exciting' and 'Could you say that again?'. Now: the request is answered with its made-up tail stripped; made-up lines get no answer. (The write flow for 'for two' = 2 pm is the next fix.) (16 Oct: a bare 'Yeah.' with the meeting card open may get the card's honest status: 'I haven't added it yet. Tap Add …'.)
